missing_fields: The source supplies no stand-alone numeric calculated gap for Cs3Cu2Cl5, only a difference relative to the reported Br value.
The white-light ratio/CIE/CCT/CRI are presented as an appropriate spectral combination/simulation; no physical mixed batch preparation is reported.
Matching SI (SHA-256 c6afc558d42c61cc99d4e0f44321fef222ec93d3563d186e40a1d1487527a8f2) is present locally but unadmitted, unread, and unused; SI-dependent details remain unverified.

The main text does not settle the relationship between the approximately 4.4 eV absorption-edge-associated statement near 275 nm and the separately stated DFT theoretical gaps. Their bases are preserved separately pending independent classification; no gap correction is inferred.
